caption: A magnetic wand is dragged over a tray of iron filings, and the filings clump onto the wand in fuzzy bristles.

sa.check: A magnetic wand is dragged over the tray.
The gathered filings stand off the wand as fuzzy bristles or spikes.
The wand's pass comes first and the clumping follows.

pc.expect: The filings lie still until the wand comes over them and gather only where the wand is close; filings away from the wand stay put, and stay put after it has passed.
pc.fail: Filings rise or crawl toward the wand while it is still across the tray from them; or the whole tray of filings stirs at once; or filings jump up where the wand has not been; or filings in the tray keep shifting after the wand has left the tray.

pc.expect: Filings on the wand hang from it and stand out from it in spikes, in contact with it; any that come loose fall down into the tray.
pc.fail: Loose filings drift upward or float in the air away from the wand; or filings hang in a cloud below the wand without touching it; or filings that drop off fall sideways or upward.

pc.expect: The bristles are short stiff spikes standing out from the wand; the filings remain separate grains and the tray stays rigid.
pc.fail: The filings coat the wand as a smooth paint-like skin; or run up the wand like a liquid; or the tray bends as the wand passes over it.

pc.expect: The clumps travel with the wand as it moves, staying attached; the tray stays where it is.
pc.fail: Clumps stay hanging in mid-air where the wand was after it has moved on; or the tray slides along beneath the wand; or filings on the wand crawl along it toward one end while the wand is held level.

pc.expect: One wand and one tray; filings leave the tray only onto the wand and return only by falling; the wand does not pass through the tray.
pc.fail: The wand passes through the tray's rim or bottom; or a second wand appears; or the clumps vanish from the wand in mid-air with nothing falling; or the tray's filings disappear without being on the wand.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wand's colour and length, the tray and the surface it sits on stay the same; the filings stay dark grey.
pc.fail: The wand changes colour or length; or the filings change colour; or the tray changes shape or pattern.
